verdict.rationale: Aircall's pricing page says the product itself routes incoming calls through a keypad menu (IVR) so callers reach the right team, with business-hours scheduling. That matches the 'press 1 for sales' story directly. The developer smart-routing and overflow tutorials are code-it-yourself building blocks and add no credit here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how a support leader configures the IVR menu (menu builder, key-to-team mapping, nested options), plus any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can build a phone menu (press 1 for sales) that routes callers to teams

citations.quote: Route incoming calls automatically using a keypad menu (IVR) so callers can reach the right team, combined with business-hours scheduling
